name: Remote Services: SSH
description: Use Secure Shell (SSH) with valid accounts to access a remote Linux, macOS, or ESXi system and run commands as the logged-on user.

name: Lateral Tool Transfer
description: Transfer tools or payload files between systems in a compromised environment using scp, sftp, rsync, SMB, or other native transfer methods.

name: Command and Scripting Interpreter: Unix Shell
description: Execute commands or scripts through Unix shells such as sh, bash, or zsh, including chained commands, permission changes, and payload execution.

name: Create Account: Local Account
description: Create a local operating-system account to maintain access to a host, often with commands or native account-management tools.

name: Valid Accounts
tactic: Defense Evasion, Persistence, Privilege Escalation, Initial Access
description: Use legitimate credentials for local, domain, cloud, or service accounts to access systems and perform actions as an authorized user.

name: Credentials from Password Stores: Credentials from Web Browsers
description: Extract saved usernames, passwords, cookies, or other credentials from web browsers and browser profile stores.

name: Unsecured Credentials: Credentials In Files
description: Search files, configuration, shell history, scripts, or other local content for plaintext or otherwise unsecured credentials.

name: Data from Local System
description: Collect files and data from local file systems or databases on a compromised host.

name: Screen Capture
description: Capture screenshots or screen video to collect visible user, application, or credential information.

name: Data Staged: Local Data Staging
description: Stage collected data in a local directory or file before exfiltration, often by copying selected content into a temporary location.

name: Archive Collected Data: Archive via Utility
description: Compress or archive collected files with utilities such as tar, gzip, zip, or rar to prepare data for transfer.

name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
description: Exfiltrate collected data through an existing command-and-control channel.

name: Ingress Tool Transfer
description: Transfer tools or files from an external system into a compromised environment, including downloads with curl, wget, FTP, or other protocols.

name: Account Discovery: Local Account
description: Enumerate local operating-system accounts and account details using commands, APIs, or system files.

name: System Information Discovery
description: Collect operating-system, host name, version, architecture, or other system details from a host.

name: System Network Configuration Discovery
description: Discover network interfaces, addresses, routes, DNS settings, or other network configuration details.

name: File and Directory Discovery
description: Enumerate files and directories or search for paths and content of interest on a system.
